help.title: Docs — Serpmonn partner network
help.lead: Short guides for advertisers and publishers: offers, links, conversions, and moderation.
help.adv.body:
Advertisers place offers and pay for confirmed conversions. Publishers take offers and put links on their sites.

  1. Registration as Advertiser and sign-in to the cabinet.
  2. Balance top-up in the Money tab (request or payment).
  3. Offer creation: promo or CPA, landing, terms, rate, and hold (0–180 days).
  4. For Russia — an ERID (ORD marking token).
  5. Submission for moderation. After publish the offer appears for publishers.
  6. Conversion reporting setup (see below) — otherwise only clicks remain in stats.

Each conversion charges the publisher rate plus the network fee (usually 10%). Publisher hold is set per offer.
help.pub.body:
Publishers take published offers and place a tracked link. Payout is for conversions confirmed by the advertiser.

  1. Registration as Publisher — a site code is issued.
  2. In the catalog, copy a link like /go/…?p=code. The hold column shows how many days until payout unlocks.
  3. The link is placed on a site or in mailings. Clicks without ?p= are ignored.
  4. Stats and available balance are in the cabinet.
  5. Withdrawal is requested from the cabinet; payout is confirmed by the network.
help.track.body:
Click. The publisher places a link like /go/…?p=code. The user follows it: the click is recorded and the browser is redirected to the advertiser landing with click_id in the URL. That id must be stored (cookie, CRM, or a hidden form field).

Conversion. When the client buys or leaves a lead, the advertiser site or CRM calls the postback once with the stored click_id and amount.

The template is in the advertiser cabinet under Conversion reporting. Example:

/api/partners/postback?click_id=…&amount=500&status=confirmed

For reject or chargeback: status=rejected with the same click_id.

Without postback only clicks remain in reports. No custom API is required — a normal HTTP request is enough.
help.mod.body:
New and edited offers are reviewed by the network before publish.

  • Landing, terms, rate, and (for RU) ERID are checked.
  • Statuses in the cabinet: in moderation, published, rejected, draft.
  • On rejection the reason is shown in the offer list; after fixes the offer is resubmitted.
  • Unpublishing moves the offer to draft — publishers no longer see it.

help.intro.body:
The Serpmonn partner network connects companies and audience-owned properties in a single placement model.

  • Advertiser publishes an offer: the proposition, terms, and reward for a completed action.
  • Publisher promotes the offer via a partner link on their property and is paid for confirmed results.

Payouts are for conversions — when a user follows the link and completes the target action under the offer terms (lead, purchase, etc.).

Publishers need a property or channel with an audience: registration, offer selection, link placement, then stats and payouts in the cabinet.

Below are instructions for cabinets, tracking, and moderation.

adv.body:
Naglalagay ang advertiser ng offer at nagbabayad para sa kumpirmadong conversion. Kinukuha ng publisher ang offer at naglalagay ng link sa kanilang site.

  1. Pagpaparehistro bilang Advertiser at pag-sign in sa cabinet.
  2. Pag-top up ng balance sa tab na Money (request o bayad).
  3. Paglikha ng offer: promo o CPA, landing, terms, rate, at hold (0–180 araw).
  4. Para sa Russia — isang ERID (ORD marking token).
  5. Pagsumite para sa moderation. Pagkatapos ma-publish, lumilitaw ang offer sa mga publisher.
  6. Setup ng conversion reporting (tingnan sa ibaba) — kung hindi, clicks lang ang mananatili sa stats.

Bawat conversion ay sinisingil ang rate ng publisher kasama ang network fee (karaniwang 10%). Ang hold ng publisher ay itinakda sa bawat offer.

pub.body:
Kinukuha ng publisher ang na-publish na offer at naglalagay ng tracked link. Ang payout ay para sa conversion na kinumpirma ng advertiser.

  1. Pagpaparehistro bilang Publisher — may ibinibigay na site code.
  2. Sa catalog, kopyahin ang link tulad ng /go/…?p=code. Ipinapakita ng hold column kung ilang araw hanggang ma-unlock ang payout.
  3. Inilalagay ang link sa site o sa mailing. Hindi isinasaalang-alang ang click na walang ?p=.
  4. Nasa cabinet ang stats at available balance.
  5. Hiniling ang withdrawal mula sa cabinet; kinukumpirma ng network ang payout.

track.body:
Click. Naglalagay ang publisher ng link tulad ng /go/…?p=code. Sinusundan ito ng user: naitatala ang click at nire-redirect ang browser sa advertiser landing na may click_id sa URL. Dapat itago ang id na iyon (cookie, CRM, o hidden form field).

Conversion. Kapag bumili ang client o nag-iwan ng lead, tinatawag ng advertiser site o CRM ang postback nang isang beses gamit ang naka-store na click_id at amount.

Nasa advertiser cabinet ang template sa ilalim ng Conversion reporting. Halimbawa:

/api/partners/postback?click_id=…&amount=500&status=confirmed

Para sa reject o chargeback: status=rejected na may parehong click_id.

Kung walang postback, clicks lang ang mananatili sa report. Hindi kailangan ng custom API — sapat na ang normal na HTTP request.

mod.body:
Sinusuri ng network ang bago at na-edit na offer bago i-publish.

  • Sinusuri ang landing, terms, rate, at (para sa RU) ERID.
  • Status sa cabinet: in moderation, published, rejected, draft.
  • Kapag na-reject, ipinapakita ang dahilan sa listahan ng offer; pagkatapos ayusin, muling isinusumite ang offer.
  • Ang unpublishing ay inililipat ang offer sa draft — hindi na ito makikita ng mga publisher.

intro.body:
Ikinokonekta ng partner network ng Serpmonn ang mga kumpanya at property na may audience sa iisang modelo ng placement.

  • Advertiser ay nagpa-publish ng offer: ang proposition, terms, at gantimpala para sa nakumpletong aksyon.
  • Publisher ay nagpo-promote ng offer sa pamamagitan ng partner link sa kanilang property at binabayaran para sa kumpirmadong resulta.

Ang payout ay para sa conversion — kapag sinundan ng user ang link at nakumpleto ang target action ayon sa terms ng offer (lead, purchase, atbp.).

Kailangan ng publisher ng property o channel na may audience: pagpaparehistro, pagpili ng offer, paglalagay ng link, pagkatapos ay stats at payout sa cabinet.

Nasa ibaba ang mga instruksyon para sa cabinet, tracking, at moderation.
